scope: Distinct original infernal graphics for demon, abyss_walker and abyss_lord

checks.name: Final server catalogue maps all three infernal kinds to their own SVG sheet
Each sheet contains four 80 by 80 movement frames; dimensions 320 by 80
Web and Godot client copies are byte-identical
Dragon, dragon_lord and ancient_dragon retain dragon appearance and do not reference infernal sprites
Production BractwoLootUI.drawMonster rendered all four frames, both facings, and final 1.8/1.7/2.2 actor sizes in Chromium
Production drawNewCreature fallback rendered three horned humanoid demons and the distinct winged dragon
Visual review of demon_preview.png confirmed distinct silhouettes, variants and unclipped sprites
Chromium render session reported no page errors
Python compilation of generator and world_content.py

limitations: Godot executable was unavailable; its fallback source was updated but not runtime-tested.
Browser verification used the production drawing functions on a local review canvas, not a live multiplayer encounter.
